free_text: The panel protocol suggested no biopsy based on an identical precedent in the labelled series, but the Verifier indicated the decision is not ready because the documented grade of the prior biopsy is missing. The rising PSA trend (from 3.7 to 8.3 ng/mL) and PI-RADS 5 are important factors, but the lack of documented histological information prevents a definitive decision. Therefore, the case cannot be decided yet, and a deferral is appropriate pending retrieval of the prior biopsy grade.
